note: WebFetch returned 403 or cookie walls on PubMed, NEJM, NCBI Bookshelf, ScienceDirect, Wiley; used PubMed eutils via curl and other open pages. Claims not backed by an opened page are unverifiable. No option text was cut off mid-sentence. 3 claims per lesson.

questions.note: 2024 ACC/AHA allows bridging only in highest thrombotic risk; for hernia repair in AF (CHA2DS2-VASc unknown) no routine bridging is best.
Several options are loosely true of obstruction; 'peritonitis, acidosis or strangulation' is clearly the operative indication.
5.5 cm matches SVS/ESVS thresholds for men.
Under ATLS 11 (xABCDE) the order after x is A, B, C, D, E; choice 0 matches, but wording 'usual order' is loose.
